create_PointNavBaselinePolicy: create a PointNavBaselinePolicy from config with observation space and action space for PPO navigation
build_PointNavBaselineNet: build a PointNavBaselineNet that fuses CNN visual features with goal vectors through an RNN state encoder
run_NetPolicy_act: run the NetPolicy act method to sample actions and get log probabilities from observations
evaluate_NetPolicy_actions: evaluate actions with NetPolicy to get values, log probs, entropy, and auxiliary losses for PPO training
create_PolicyActionData: create a PolicyActionData object to store actions, values, log probs, and RNN hidden states from policy
